## Summary

I implemented `listTools` and `callTool` in `server.mjs` for a notes MCP server:

**`listTools`** — exposes two tools, each with a strict JSON schema (`additionalProperties: false`):
- `note_create`: requires `title` and `body` (both strings).
- `note_get`: requires `note_id` (string).

**`callTool`** — dispatches to the two tools with validation:
- `note_create` validates that `title` and `body` are non-empty strings, stores the note in an in-memory `Map` keyed by a stable generated id (`n1`, `n2`, …), and returns structured text content.
- `note_get` validates `note_id`, looks up the stored note, and returns structured text content (or throws `Note not found`).
- Any unknown tool name throws `Unknown tool`.

Invalid inputs (missing/empty/non-string) and unknown tools are rejected by throwing errors, which the existing `protocol.mjs` wrapper translates into JSON-RPC error responses. Both provided tests pass, and the full behavior (strict schemas, stable ids, rejection paths) was verified.
